rows.note: Use 階段 as the all-purpose choice for a phase understood as a stage in a process or cycle.

example.english: The project has now reached its final phase.
example.traditional: 呢個計劃而家去到最後階段喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 ji4 gaa1 heoi3 dou3 zeoi3 hau6 gaai1 dyun6 laa3

rows.note: Use 方面 when phase means one aspect or angle of a problem or subject.

example.english: At this phase, the problem still has many loopholes in terms of safety.
example.traditional: 去到呢個階段，個問題喺安全方面仲有好多漏洞。
example.jyutping: heoi3 dou3 ni1 go3 gaai1 dyun6 go3 man6 tai4 hai2 on1 cyun4 fong1 min6 zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 lau6 dung6

rows.note: Use 月相 specifically for the changing illuminated appearance of the moon.

example.english: The lunar phase changes every few days.
example.traditional: 月相每隔幾日就會變化。
example.jyutping: jyut6 soeng3 mui5 gaak3 gei2 jat6 zau6 wui5 bin3 faa3

rows.note: Use 相位 in physics for the phase position of a wave or vibration.

example.english: The phase of this wave doesn't match that of the other one.
example.traditional: 呢條波嘅相位同嗰條唔一致。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 bo1 ge3 soeng1 wai6 tung4 go2 tiu4 m4 jat1 zi3
